measurement_correction.reason: iperf3 3.18 reported negative UDP lost_packets under normal jitter with -O1. Upstream computes cnt_error minus omitted_cnt_error; late reordering can alter the earlier omitted loss estimate. Negative results are not physical packet losses.
measurement_correction.action: Stopped only the host scheduler; its active group finishes. Preserve exploratory files and repeat the matrix with -O0 and unique names. Add lightweight exit socket-drop sampling. VPN/profiles/filter/rules unchanged.

UDP_capture_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic UDP captures include every test datagram through B tunnel decryption; capture CPU remains measured separately from the primary cohort.
